title: Warm Malaysian Beef Tagine
description: A malty, crumbly, festive Malaysian dish featuring hot beef stock, cooked in a tagine, suitable for diabetics. This hearty stew is a perfect blend of Asian and African flavors.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef stock, dried apricots, prunes, and almonds, then bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven, then cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Season the tagine with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and scallions.
Serve over couscous or with crusty bread, if desired.
